At Best Friends Veterinary Center we emphasize high quality patient care as well as friendly, helpful customer service. It's part of our mission to help educate about pet health care.  Medical, surgical and dental care are all available at Best Friends. We offer the best and safest protocols for pets, including canine rehabilitation, dental radiographs, laser surgery and specialty services. 

We have been serving the Ozaukee area for over 30 years and are convenient to Cedarburg, Mequon, Port Washington, Saukville and northern Milwaukee County
